title: Change in bonus rates for Save As You Earn (SAYE) share option schemes
text: Both the 3-year and 5-year rates for Save As You Earn ( SAYE ) share option schemes will change on the 15th day following a change in the Bank of England Bank Rate, as set out in the SAYE bonus rates automatic mechanism .
changeNote: The new Save As You Earn (SAYE) bonus rates and early leaver rates that apply from 20 November 2026 have been added.
